S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S042.name: Low_Self_Esteem
S042.description: A persistent tendency to evaluate oneself as incompetent or worthless; chronically low self-evaluation.

subtypes.Feelings of Worthlessness: A persistent perception that one is useless or inferior to others.
subtypes.Self-Criticism: Excessively and repeatedly blaming oneself for past minor failures or flaws.
subtypes.Reduced Self-Efficacy: Distrust in one's own ability to perform tasks or solve problems.
subtypes.Chronic Sense of Inferiority: Persistently evaluating oneself lower in comparison to others.
subtypes.Lack of Self-Assurance: Continually feeling anxious and unsure about decisions or actions.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.

subtypes.Future Hopelessness: The persistent conviction that the future holds no possibility of improvement.
subtypes.Belief in Impossibility of Improvement: The belief that the current situation will absolutely not get better.
subtypes.Helpless Resignation: A state of helplessness and resignation, believing that nothing will change despite effort.
subtypes.Chronic Pessimism: A persistent tendency to view everything negatively and fail to consider positive possibilities.

patient_info.stressor: When Alex was recognized at work for building a data dashboard that saved his department weeks of duplicated effort, the achievement quickly led to higher expectations, more visible meetings, and talk of him becoming the youngest analyst on a major workflow redesign. Over the next 2 years and 2 months, the pride he initially felt gave way to a persistently depressed outlook, draining fatigue, and a growing conviction that the praise had been undeserved, which began affecting his paperwork, soccer commitments, volunteering, and MBA planning. His sense that the future he had been carefully spreadsheeting no longer seemed attainable became clinically significant after a performance review noted slipping follow-through despite strong technical skill. Alex eventually used his company’s employee assistance program and was referred for psychiatric evaluation after describing the long duration and work impairment.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: I came in because for a long time now I’ve been walking around with this flat, heavy feeling, like even when work is going okay or people are nice to me, I still feel down and kind of empty most days.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: By the afternoon I’m so wiped out that even fixing a spreadsheet error, finishing expense paperwork, or getting myself to soccer feels like I’m dragging my body and my brain through mud.

S042.name: Low_Self_Esteem
S042.description: A persistent tendency to evaluate oneself as incompetent or worthless; chronically low self-evaluation.
S042.manifestation: When people at work still bring up that dashboard I built, my first thought is that I somehow fooled them, and every missed follow-up or late email feels like proof that I’m not actually as capable as they think.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.
S083.manifestation: I used to map out my MBA plans and career steps in detail, but lately I look at those same plans and just assume I’m not going to get there no matter how much I try.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: My performance review actually called out that I’m missing follow-through now, and outside work I’ve been dropping soccer commitments, volunteering, and the MBA planning I used to stay on top of.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about two years and two months, ever since the dashboard project put me in the spotlight at work.
